title: Herbed Saudi Arabian Lamb Roast
description: A smoky, crisp lamb roast infused with scotch bonnet heat and aromatic Saudi herbs, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Rub lamb leg with olive oil, then with za'atar, sumac, rosemary, minced garlic, salt and pepper.
Place quartered onion, lemon slices, and chopped scotch bonnets around the lamb in a roasting pan.
Pour beef broth into the pan, ensuring it stays below the lamb surface.
Roast lamb for 90 minutes, basting every 30 minutes with pan juices.
After 90 minutes, increase oven temperature to 425°F (220°C) and roast for an additional 10 minutes to crisp the exterior.
Remove lamb from oven and let it rest for 15 minutes before slicing.
Spoon pan juices over the sliced lamb to add moisture and flavor.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with fresh parsley or additional za'atar.
Enjoy the smoky, crisp lamb roast with a side of whole30-friendly salad or roasted vegetables.
